INFERENCE: the market is pricing a one-way RBA-over-RBNZ regime that is internally inconsistent with housing and with NZ data, so the next move is a distribution with a delayed mean-reversion tail and a squeeze tail. Spot is dominated because timing is uncertain and event risk is two-sided after realized FX vol on this cross stayed near 5 percent. Buying USDJPY vol after a +1.41 percent BoJ day is not the same trade: that realized has already printed. UNKNOWN: 3M ATMF IV, 25-delta risk-reversal, quoted premium, strike grid, and the RBNZ curve.
